requiredCount.freezeRule: Determine once at session start and persist it.

fixedSet.selection: Select requiredCount distinct eligible questionIds at session start.
fixedSet.immutability: Never replace, append, or rerandomize the set during the session.
fixedSet.firstPass: Present every unresolved fixed item in saved order.
fixedSet.retry: After the first pass, present only wrong or assisted unresolved items in fixed-set order.
fixedSet.completion: Complete when every fixed item has one qualifying correct answer.
fixedSet.shortage: Use every available distinct item, lower persisted requiredCount, and never duplicate an item.

hardRules: A qualifying answer is first-submission correct with no hint, explanation, or revealed answer.
A wrong or assisted answer never removes another question's completed state.
A completed question is not presented again in the same session.
Reload and Home resume preserve the fixed set, order, completed state, and retry state.
A newer unresolved source attempt starts a new fixed session without deleting history.
Category changes never change questionId, seen status, or past attempts.
Only masteryEligibleQuestionIds may enter a fixed set.

backlog.rule: 2019-2021-derived Level2 items remain stored but excluded from active pools.
backlog.reactivation: Review one item at a time before reactivation.
